title: Why Most Multi-Agent AI Is a Workaround
description:
Adding more agents can look like progress while quietly turning the system into a routing workaround that never fixed the real design problem.

This cinematic brief reframes the multi-agent boom as a temporary coping mechanism for action spaces that were never decomposed cleanly enough in the first place.

It is meant to land one durable claim quickly for operators and builders: better decomposition often beats louder coordination theater.
